Recreation & Fitness Memberships

The City of Gulf Shores Recreation Division strives to provide exceptional recreation and fitness centers to improve the quality of life for all residents and visitors. In addition to our fitness centers, we provide numerous athletic opportunities for all ages through our Youth & Adult Sports.

Recreation & Fitness Centers Include:



David L. Bodenhamer Center  
The David L. Bodenhamer Center is a membership based community center that receives over 350,000 visits annually. The beautifully designed facility is home to the City of Gulf Shores Recreation Division offices and is the hub for all recreational athletic and program registrations. Click here

Studio Fit – Cultural Center  
Studio Fitness at the Cultural Center opened in July 2017. Studio Fit features a limited selection of functional equipment and classrooms specifically designed to accommodate workout programs such as Barre, TRX Suspension Training, Yoga and Indoor Cycling.  The facility is a secondary location available for use with our Recreation Membership Pass. Click here

City Store






Shop in-store or online

The Gulf Shores City Store is conveniently located at the corner of Clubhouse Drive and HWY 59. You can also shop official Gulf Shores merchandise at the Bodenhamer Recreation Center, Tennis Center, and the Museum. The City Store is open Monday - Friday 8AM - 5:00PM and Saturdays 10AM - 3PM. Shop online at www.gulfshoresgear.com. If you have any questions regarding the City Store, please call 251-968-2504. *Military personnel and veterans receive a 10% discount with proper identification.

History

The current City Store building was the first Gulf Shores Tourist Information Center, established in 1966, and was relocated and renovated in 1972, coinciding with the dedication of the W.C. Holmes Bridge. Throughout the 1980s, Wingard’s Jewelry Shop, operated by Al Wingard, was located there. Wade Ward Real Estate was the final tenant before the property was purchased and donated to the City.

Pictorial History Book

The City of Gulf Shores is proud to announce the release of Small Town, Big Beach, the first edition of a stunning pictorial history coffee table book that preserves, celebrates, and shares the community’s story with residents and visitors alike.

Spearheaded by the City of Gulf Shores and published and curated by PV Publications, Inc., this year-and-a-half-long project captures Gulf Shores’ journey from a small coastal town to a world-class destination — while honoring the people whose dedication continues to define it.

Filled with historic photographs from private collections and archives, the book offers a rare glimpse into the past through first-hand accounts from residents and local leaders. Stunning scenic imagery captures the natural beauty of Alabama’s Gulf Coast, while engaging narratives highlight beloved landmarks, cherished traditions, and the community milestones that have shaped Gulf Shores into the vibrant coastal town it is today.

Perfect for long-time residents, new community members, and anyone who loves the Alabama Gulf Coast, this pictorial history book serves as both a treasured keepsake and an invaluable record for future generations. 

 Additional copies of the book are available for purchase at the Gulf Shores City Store, the Gulf Shores Museum and online at www.gulfshoresgear.com 

For more information about the first official Pictorial History Book, contact the City Store at 251-968-2504.

Beach Safety

The City of Gulf Shores provides seasonal lifeguard services between March and October and encourages the public to swim at the protected public swimming areas (Gulf Place, West 6th Street, and Lagoon Pass) when lifeguards are present. Six full-time beach safety supervisors and seasonal lifeguards make up the City of Gulf Shores Beach Patrol.

Beach Warning Flags 

Before heading out to the beach, check for current beach conditions to ensure you have a safe and fun experience. Beach flags are posted at all public beach areas and lifeguard towers in Gulf Shores. Please remember that the absence of beach flags does not constitute safe swimming conditions. 

Please note: Within the corporate limits of Gulf Shores, it is ILLEGAL to enter the Gulf of Mexico when double red flags are flying. Those who enter the Gulf waters when double red flags are displayed will be subject to a fine and possible arrest

Know before you go!

Checking beach conditions is easy! Before entering the water, please check current conditions in one of the following ways:

Call 251-968-SURF (7873). 
Visit www.gulfshoresAL.gov.
Text "ALBEACHES" to 888-777 to receive daily beach conditions via text message.
Beware of Rip Currents

Rip currents are strong currents of water that quickly flow away from shore at surf beaches. They typically form at breaks in sandbars and near structures such as jetties and piers. Watch the video below for more information on how to identify and escape rip currents.

Click here
Beach Safety
 to view the latest rip current & surf report. 

Red Tide

Red tide results from a massive build-up of certain species of microscopic sea organisms known as dinoflagellates. These organisms produce a toxin that affects the central nervous system of fish so they are paralyzed and cannot breathe. At high concentrations, the organisms may produce a discoloration of the water. Red tides are often referred to as “blooms.” The species (Karenia brevis), isolated from waters along the Gulf Coast, may produce toxins that also cause skin irritation and respiratory problems in humans.

Health Department officials advise: 

Avoid the area if you are susceptible to respiratory problems such as asthma or emphysema.
Leave the water if you experience skin irritations while swimming or boating and rinse immediately with fresh water.
If you experience nose, throat or eye irritation when exposed to the gulf mist, avoid the mist.
Do not eat fish from the red tide-affected area that are lethargic, swim in circles or appear unhealthy.
For addition information, visit www.alabamapublichealth.gov or contact the Alabama Department of Public Health at 334-206-5300. 


Public Beach Access

The City of Gulf Shores offers several public beach access areas. Find information about beach access and parking fees.

David L. Bodenhamer Recreation Center




The David L. Bodenhamer Center is a membership-based community center that receives over 350,000 visits annually. The beautifully designed facility is home to the City of Gulf Shores Recreation Division offices and is the hub for all recreational, athletic, and program registrations. 


Hours of Operation

Monday - Friday: 5:30 am-8 pm
Saturday: 8 am-6 pm
Sunday: 1 pm-6 pm

Facility Amenities Include:
ADA accessible
AquaClimb ® wall in pool
Floor and water aerobics classes
Full-service fitness room, including free weights
Game area
Indoor heated pool with lap lanes
Indoor walking/jogging track
Men's/Women's and Boy's/Girl's locker rooms
Outdoor children's wading pool
Racquetball courts (2)
Regulation-sized gymnasium
Large variety of Cardio equipment
Memberships

We offer a variety of membership options for residents and non-residents. Click here 
 Version Options David L. Bodenhamer Recreation Center Headline
for more information about membership rates. 

Bodenhamer Indoor Pool

Our heated indoor pool features dedicated lap lanes and hosts a variety of aquatic programs throughout the week. Because swim lessons, team practices, classes, and other activities take place regularly, pool hours and available areas may vary. Please call us at 251‑968‑1420 to confirm the current schedule before your visit, as certain sections of the pool may be limited during programmed activities. To view weekly pool hours, visit the Bodenhamer Recreation Center Pool Hours page.

Pool Party Rentals

Pool Rentals are coordinated through the Aquatics Coordinator and our team of lifeguards.  For information, please call 251-968-1427.

Swimming & Aquatics Programs

The Gulf Shores Swim Team and Aquatic Programs are provided by the City of Gulf Shores Recreation Division at the David L. Bodenhamer Center. The aquatic program offers a variety of instructional classes, including water aerobics, lifeguard certification, group lessons, and more. We pride ourselves in our comprehensive programming that allows us to provide everyone an opportunity to improve swimming skills and achieve success at his or her level of ability, from novice to national competitor. For more information, visit our Swimming & Aquatics page by clicking here

Group Fitness Classes

A variety of classes are available at the David L. Bodenhamer Center, including Zumba, Water arthritis, Yoga, and Pilates. Drop-In Floor classes are included with RecPass and FitPass memberships.  Drop-In Pool classes are included with RecPass and SplashPass memberships. Entry is monitored by the instructor and is on a first-come, first-served basis. To view the full schedule of fitness classes offered at our recreation and fitness centers, please click here

The City of Gulf Shores Recreation Division strives to provide exceptional recreation and fitness centers to improve the quality of life for all residents and visitors. View our membership handbook to learn about our memberships and more!

Membership & Daily Pass Rates

The David L. Bodenhamer Center and Cultural Center (Studio Fit) are membership-based facilities that receive over 350,000 visits combined annually. The centers are home to the Recreation Division Offices and are the hub for all recreational athletic and program registrations.  In addition, the facilities offer a large variety of fitness programs and classes suited to fit your specific wellness needs.  

The Recreation Division offers a variety of membership options available for singles, couples, families, and seniors. Whether you are looking for family fun for a day or a membership for the year, our many options have you covered.

The City of Gulf Shores Recreation Division strives to provide exceptional recreation and fitness centers to improve the quality of life for all residents and visitors. View our membership handbook to learn about our memberships and more!

Fitness Class Schedule

David L. Bodenhamer Recreation Center

A variety of floor classes are available at the David L. Bodenhamer Center including Zumba, Yoga and Pilates.  Drop-In Floor classes are included with RecPass and fitness memberships.  The public can purchase a $10 daily pass at the front desk. Entry is monitored by the instructor and is on a first come, first serve basis.

Studio Fit - Cultural Center

Studio Fit features a limited selection of functional equipment and classrooms specifically designed to accommodate workout programs such as Barre, TRX Suspension Training, Yoga, and Indoor Cycling. Aerobic classes with instructors will be held on a weekly class schedule at the Cultural Center.

City of Gulf Shores News & Alerts
Sign up to stay informed and current on all City of Gulf Shores news.

The City of Gulf Shores can send you updates and alerts directly to your phone and email! To sign up, click on the button below, and you will be directed to a registration form. When registering, you can select what news categories you want to receive updates on and sign up for emergency alerts.

Please provide complete contact information, including your address, when you sign up for notifications. Geotargeted alerts may be sent out in the event of an emergency, as well as non-emergency incidents, that may significantly impact residents in a specific location. Adding your address will allow tailoring so you do not receive geotargeted alerts that do not pertain to your geographical area. 

Alerts are provided free of charge. Standard text messaging rates and other charges may apply.

Come join us for Family Bingo Night! Tickets are $5 and registration includes a slice of pizza, chips, a cookie, a drink, and a chance to win awesome prizes! Family Bingo Night will take place in the Cultural Center Gymnasium and begins at 5:45 p.m. The first call is at 6:00 p.m.

Tickets for our 2026 Daddy Daughter Dance have SOLD OUT!

Swimming & Aquatic Programs

The Gulf Shores Swim Team and Aquatic Programs are provided by the City of Gulf Shores Recreation Division at the David L. Bodenhamer Center. The aquatic program offers a variety of instructional classes, including water aerobics, lifeguard certification, group lessons, and more. We pride ourselves in our comprehensive programming that allows us to provide everyone an opportunity to improve swimming skills and achieve success at his or her level of ability, from novice to national competitor.
